name: Robin Goodfellow
source:
Robin Goodfellow (neither good nor a fellow) is an ever constant, if perplexing presence in the Unseelie Court. Though the Unseelie are well known for the unusual curiosities among their ranks, Robin stands unique for the fact they are a relative newcomer, having played no part in the War of the Courts. Rather, they instead imposed themselves upon the lot, and no one has yet managed to get rid of them. Still, it would be untrue to state that the shapeshifting fool is wholly unwelcome. In fact, it is often said that the only reason the fearsome King Lugaid never skinned the fur from Robin's back is because they were the only one to ever make the rebel King laugh, while daring to insult him to his face, no less.

Still, despite their joviality and devil-may-care attitude, Robin is capable of far more than most are willing to acknowledge. Shapeshifting, teleportation, and a silver tongue... These are not common gifts among the Tuatha Dé, nor even the Druids. To Goodfellow, though, they are as effortless as breathing... which does make one wonder. Who, or what exactly, is Robin Goodfellow?
